lastUpdated.patchNote: Changed by [Chaos: A Realm Divided] Season Announcement (2026-06-25). Block break value 1400→1100 (nerf); new tag: all attacks vs Heroes take 60% armour penetration reduction and 40% damage reduction

battleRole.role: Unique kit that doesn't fit the standard type/weapon pairing

entries.text: No hero pairing specified by the Amya guide (source shows "X" / none specified).

steps.text: Engage with spell 1 from mid-close range. Once engaged, press 2 for a heavy burst (mace swipe), let it run 3-4s, then press 3, then press 2 again as soon as it is off cooldown.
Most damage comes from the Bludgeon (mace).
Low blob-fight potential but a good flanker and clean-up unit.

steps.context: post-nerf note (pre-2026-06 patch source; superseded by the larger 2026-06 block-break nerf)
steps.text: A prior nerf added a small delay to pressing spell 2 — still best to engage with it; does not change blob/flank performance but reduces skirmish and duelling power notably.

Movement speed leverages damage, BUT entering a blob at very low speed can be better when enemy pikes are present — their damage buff from the unit’s own speed can one-shot it before the speed-damage modifier pays off.

gaps.note: No dedicated formation guidance exists in unit-db for this unit (only captured for units with a video-transcript source).
